pois.name: Westgate Buildings
pois.description: A 19th Century hotel building which was the site of the pro democracy Newport Rising riot on 4 November 1839, led by John Frost. Protesters sought the release of five men under arrest at the hotel, leading to 100 British Army soldiers killing 22 Chartists

pois.name: Caerleon Roman Amphitheatre

pois.name: The Mynde
pois.description: Six properties which previously served as a fortified estate, built by a local industrialist during the Chartist Risings to protect against his workers. Consists of a large expanse of elevated grass land and a 5-6m tall stone wall.

pois.name: Stone cherub
pois.description: Stone cherub bearing the Newport coat of arms. Featured on the Stone Roses album cover Love Spreads.
